title: 3BR Rosemary Beach Villa with Beach and Pool Access
meta_description: Stay at Belize Cottage, a 3BR, 2.5BA villa in Rosemary Beach with open concept living, private beach access, near Coquina Pool, and a balcony. Sleeps 8.
description_expanded: DescriptionWhat Guests Love- 4 Complimentary Beach Cruiser Bikes- Outdoor Dining with Terrace and Fountain- 90 feet from the Coquina Pool- 300 feet from the Eastern Green, which overlooks the gulfThe Belize Cottage is reminiscent of a Mediterranean-style villa with white plaster walls and ceilings above exposed log beams. The living, dining, and kitchen areas are open, and can accommodate several conversation groups simultaneously. The space extends outdoors to a covered dining area that looks down onto a fountain terrace, which is itself surrounded by a tropical garden. A covered balcony off the main bedroom upstairs extends the full width of the house, and affords a view of the tree-lined boardwalk to the Eastern Green. Two other balconies overlook the garden below. You'll love the ambiance!Need a little more space? Check out the Belize Carriage House, located above the garage in the courtyard. Rents separately.AMENITIES- 2250 Sq. Ft., 3 Bedroom,- 2 1/2 Baths, Sleeps 8- Two Queens, Two Twins, One Queen Pull-Out Sofa- Three Balconies- Propane Weber Grill- Fully Equipped Kitchen With Refrigerator, Freezer, Dishwasher, Toaster, Coffee Maker, Blender & Microwave- Washer & Dryer, Ironing Board- High Speed Wifi- One Garage Parking Space & Street ParkingSTR-010986 TDT-010986
